svg.title: EthenaPay Daily Boost paid for October 8, 2026 against each wallet's balance, with the tier lines from Ethena Pay's terms
svg.desc: 584 dots, one per wallet that held 100 USDe or more on average on October 8, 2026 and received a Boost payment for that day, placed by its time-weighted balance on a log scale from $100 to $1,000,000 and the Boost as a yearly rate before compounding. 525 wallets had used the card at some time and 59 had never sent USDe to a settlement address through October 9. Most dots sit on one of three lines from Ethena Pay's terms. 0.50% a year on balances up to $5,000, and above that 0.50% times 5,000 divided by the balance. 1.49% a year on the whole balance, the line of 97 wallets, 7 of them above $100,000. 1.49% a year on the first $100,000, one wallet at $104,135. Wallets that never used the card sit on the same lines, the largest at $381,080 on the 1.5% line. 2 wallets above 2% are drawn at the top edge, at 7.39% and 2.11%.
svg.text: On October 8 the Boost followed the tier caps, with or without card use
Each dot is a wallet with 100 USDe or more. Boost for October 8 as a yearly rate before compounding, so 1.5% shows as 1.49%
Used the card at some time (525)
Never used the card, through October 9 (59)
Tier rates and caps in the terms
Time-weighted balance on October 8, USDe, log scale
Payments on Avalanche C-Chain, read to the end of October 9 UTC. Rates and caps, Ethena Pay FAQ, terms and pricing page.
